import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem order_462_has_nontrivial_proper_normal_subgroup {G : Type*} [Fintype G] [Group G]
  (hG : Fintype.card G = 462) :
  ∃ H : Subgroup G, H.Normal ∧ H ≠ ⊥ ∧ H ≠ ⊤ := by
  classical
  have hcard : Nat.card G = 462 := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hG
  have hp : Nat.Prime 11 := by
    norm_num
  letI : Fact (11 : ℕ).Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨P⟩ : Nonempty (Sylow 11 G) := Sylow.nonempty
  set n : ℕ := Nat.card (Sylow 11 G) with hn
  have hmod : n ≡ 1 [MOD 11] := by
    simpa [n] using (card_sylow_modEq_one 11 G)
  have hdiv_index : n ∣ P.index := by
    simpa [n] using (Sylow.card_dvd_index (p := 11) (G := G) P)
  have hindex_dvd : P.index ∣ Nat.card G := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using P.1.index_dvd_card
  have hdiv_card : n ∣ Nat.card G :=
    Nat.dvd_trans hdiv_index hindex_dvd
  have hdiv_mul : n ∣ 11 * 42 := by
    rw [hcard] at hdiv_card
    simpa using hdiv_card
  have hnotdiv : ¬11 ∣ n := by
    simpa [n] using (not_dvd_card_sylow 11 G)
  have hcoprime : Nat.Coprime n 11 := by
    simpa [Nat.coprime_comm] using (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 hnotdiv
  have hdiv42 : n ∣ 42 :=
    hcoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdiv_mul
  have hnle : n ≤ 42 :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdiv42
  have hn_eq_one : n = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.ModEq] at hmod
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv42
    have hnpos : 0 < n := by
      omega
    have hk_le : k ≤ 42 := by
      nlinarith [hk]
    interval_cases k <;> omega
  have hsub : Subsingleton (Sylow 11 G) := by
    exact (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp
      (by simpa [n] using hn_eq_one)).1
  have hnormal : P.Normal := by
    letI : Subsingleton (Sylow 11 G) := hsub
    exact Sylow.normal_of_subsingleton P
  have hdivF : 11 ∣ Fintype.card G := by
    rw [hG]
    norm_num
  have hdivF' : 11 ∣ Nat.card G := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hdivF
  have hnebot : (P : Subgroup G) ≠ ⊥ :=
    P.ne_bot_of_dvd_card hdivF'
  have hfac : Nat.factorization 462 11 = 1 := by
    rw [show (462 : ℕ) = 11 * 42 by norm_num,
      Nat.factorization_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    rw [Nat.Prime.factorization (by norm_num)]
    simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd]
  have hPcard : Nat.card (P : Subgroup G) = 11 := by
    have h := P.card_eq_multiplicity
    rw [hcard, hfac] at h
    simpa using h
  have hnetop : (P : Subgroup G) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro ht
    have hcontra : Nat.card G = 11 := by
      simpa [ht, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hPcard
    omega
  exact ⟨(P : Subgroup G), hnormal, hnebot, hnetop⟩
